limitations: Applies to the regular paperfolding convention and dyadic prefixes only; no arbitrary prefix lengths or generalized folding instructions or cyclic variants. Base finite enumerations are not substitutes for the all-length induction. Historical priority against unindexed earlier results remains open.
scientific_integrity: Proof uses a published parity lemma with explicit credit, a finite constant-size certificate, and an independent boundary-aware induction. Verification outputs correspond to embedded programs; no external independent certification is claimed.
title: Exact shortest unique factors of dyadic regular-paperfolding prefixes
